maddeler.e:
ننضبط (form VII)
# نَنْضَبِطُ (nanḍabiṭu) /nan.dˤa.bi.tˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْضَبَطَ (inḍabaṭa)
# نَنْضَبِطَ (nanḍabiṭa) /nan.dˤa.bi.tˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْضَبَطَ (inḍabaṭa)
# نَنْضَبِطْ (nanḍabiṭ) /nan.dˤa.bitˤ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْضَبَطَ (inḍabaṭa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
